name: Crop Cycle Performance Report
query:
SELECT
    -- Fields from Planting Schedule (The Plan)
    ps.name AS "Schedule ID",
    ps.title AS "Title",
    ps.crop AS "Crop",
    ps.status AS "Schedule Status",
    ps.quantity_to_plant AS "Planted Quantity",
    ps.target_planting_date AS "Planting Date",

    -- Logic to show the correct location/system
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_hydroponic_schedule = 1 THEN ps.hydroponic_system
        ELSE ps.location
    END AS "Location/System",

    -- Fields from Harvest Log (The Result)
    hl.name AS "Harvest Log ID",
    hl.modified AS "Harvest Date", -- The submission/modification date is the harvest date
    hl.total_weight_gross AS "Harvested Weight (Gross)",
    hl.waste_weight AS "Waste Weight",

    -- Calculated Performance Metrics
    hl.days_to_harvest AS "Actual Days to Harvest",
    hl.yield_per_plant_site AS "Yield per Plant Site",
    hl.waste_percentage AS "Waste Percentage"

FROM
    `tabPlanting Schedule` AS ps

-- Join the schedule to its corresponding crop cycle
LEFT JOIN
    `tabCrop Cycle` AS cc ON ps.linked_crop_cycle = cc.name

-- Join the crop cycle to its corresponding harvest log
LEFT JOIN
    `tabHarvest Log` AS hl ON hl.crop_cycle = cc.name

-- Only show schedules that have a completed harvest log
WHERE
    hl.name IS NOT NULL
    AND hl.docstatus = 1 -- Ensures the Harvest Log is Submitted
